answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in sable, verified in zephyr, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 4 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the onyx check. A farm of 4859 identities would post 3558 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
